KIRBY_MOD_POWER_INHALED_POWER.title: Inhaled

KIRBY_MOD_POWER_SWORD_POWER.title: Copy Ability: Sword
KIRBY_MOD_POWER_SWORD_POWER.description:
When gained, gain 5 [gold]Vigor[/gold]. While held, gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold]. When lost, that Strength and any unused Vigor are lost too.
When gained, add 1 [gold]Sword[/gold] card to your [gold]Hand[/gold] (a higher-rarity one if upgraded); it is [gold]Exhausted[/gold] when the ability is lost.
[gold]Sword[/gold] cards gain [gold]Retain[/gold] and their bonus.

KIRBY_MOD_POWER_TEST_SUBJECT_POWER.title: Test Subject
KIRBY_MOD_POWER_TEST_SUBJECT_POWER.descr:
At the start of each turn (before drawing), 2 random effects happen:
Enemy: 2 Vulnerable / 2 Weak / 6 Poison / -1 Strength / -8 Strength this turn / heal 20 / Stunned this turn (rare).
You or an ally: a copy of the first card it plays this turn goes to the physician's hand / lose 3 HP / 1 Artifact / +1 Strength / +1 Dexterity / +2 energy / 3 [gold]Dazed[/gold] into its hand.
